name: my-11ty-template
description: My template repo for new 11ty preojects

scripts.dev: npm run build:sass && npm run build:js && npm run serve:web & npm run watch:sass & npm run watch:js & wait
scripts.dev-no-js: npm run build:sass && npm run serve:web & npm run watch:sass & wait
scripts.build: npm run clean:site && npm run build:sass && npm run post:css && npm run clean:js && npm run build:js && npm run bundle:js && npm run build:web
scripts.serve-as-prod: npm run clean:site && npm run build:sass && npm run post:css && npm run clean:js && npm run build:js && npm run bundle:js && npm run serve:web-prod
scripts.clean: npm run clean:site && npm run clean:js && npm run clean:css

author: Matthew Nichols
